course:
The main issue with Andrea's lectures is the lack of full notes with example solutions. Once we got to topics like Dynamic Programming and Heuristics, all we did was copy whatever he wrote on the board—mostly solutions and ridiculously long equations. He was so focused on writing that he barely explained anything, and even when he did, no one really followed because it was way too much. Miss something? Too bad—it wasn’t on Moodle either.
To be fair, this probably wasn’t his fault since they just don’t share full lecture notes, but come on, these topics should be an exception to that stupid policy. Seriously, who thinks it makes sense to spend two hours in a lecture just writing nonstop, with no time to actually understand anything?
